story: Give General's launch-command check a longer timeout, since a wrapper script that sets up a toolchain can take more than 10 s to print its version.
defect: GeneralSettingsViewController now constructs its own LaunchCheckService(timeout: 30) in its init instead of taking the one the composition root built, so a second check service (with its own cache) lives outside AppDelegate's graph and the pane has no injection seam.
rule: macos/CLAUDE.md § Dependency injection & composition root — concrete services are new'd only at the composition root and handed down by initializer; never self-constructed in a VC
hit: Says GeneralSettingsViewController creates (news) a LaunchCheckService itself rather than receiving the injected one from AppDelegate/SettingsContext — a service built outside the composition root / a second instance.
